# CV-22: Home widgets, export and the shortcut sheet

Quotes are verbatim from `specs/chat-v2.md`; CH… and §6 #n point at `.design/chat-v2/REPLAN.md`, round-3 §… at `.design/chat-v2/research/round-3-database.md`; `#n` is a spec Assumption.

## 1. The row

| # | Block | Delivers | Covers | Depends on |

| 22 | **CV-22** Home widgets, export and the shortcut sheet | the Catch up widget (S and M); the Team widget's "now" rows from `chat_now` into TV-H1's slot (*until TV-H1 lands:* the Catch up widget ships and the now line waits for the Team widget TV-H1 builds); v1's Conversations widget deleted; Chat in the lossless export (files as files); Chat's rows in the shortcut sheet; `tests/chat-home`, `export.test.ts`, `chat_erasure.test.sql` extended | AC11.6, AC15.2, AC12.8, AC4.3 | 11, 17 |

**Depends on:** CV-11 (Catch up data), CV-17 (`chat_now`). TV-H1 **is landed** on this branch (the spec's "until TV-H1 lands" no longer applies): the Team widget leaves the slot `registerTeamNowLine` in `src/features/dashboard/team-now.ts`.

## 2. What to build

**§10 Presence, statuses and Focus** (prototype frames 4, 8)
- **Home:** Chat supplies each person's "now" line (Active · Focusing · Away · the status) to the one **Team** widget, above Tasks' load rows (CH70); **Catch up** is Chat's own widget (CH35).

**Edge cases this block handles** (§Edge cases)
- The export → every conversation you can read, chains, reactions, custom emoji and attachments **as files**, JSON plus a Markdown per conversation; a deleted account's rows erase every new per-person table.

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC11 — Presence, statuses and Focus**
- **AC11.6** the Team widget's "now" line and the Catch up widget on Home.

**AC15 — Module contract**
- **AC15.2** the Catch up widget and the Team widget's "now" line exist

**AC12 — Platform**
- **AC12.8** the lossless export carries every conversation you can read, with files; every new per-person table is erased with the account

**AC4 — A developer team's week**
- **AC4.3** the keyboard reaches everything in §16 and ↑ edits the last message

**Tests that prove them** (file · name · AC · plain English)

- `tests/chat-home.spec.ts` · "Catch up widget and the Team line" · proves AC11.6, AC15.2 · The Catch up widget lists what's waiting and opens it; the Team widget shows each person's now line (and Tasks' load rows once TV-H1 lands).
- `src/features/chat/export.test.ts` + `supabase/tests/chat_erasure.test.sql` · "export and erasure" · proves AC12.8 · The export holds every readable conversation with chains, reactions, files and custom emoji as files, JSON plus Markdown; the erasure removes every new per-person table and counts them in the preview.
- `tests/chat-keys.spec.ts` · "the key map" · proves AC4.3, AC4.6, AC2.7 · Every row of §16 fires in its scope and nowhere else; ↑ edits the last message; Esc follows the order; `+` never fires inside the composer.

`supabase/tests/chat_erasure.test.sql` starts in CV-1; extend it here for every per-person table created since (`user_clients`, statuses, saved statuses, chain mutes) so the preview counts them.

## 4. Decisions that bind it

- **Catch up widget** (CH35, §10 "Home"): sizes S and M, listing what is waiting and opening Catch up; its data is the open `chat_catchup` items (CV-11 exposes the read). It replaces v1's "Conversations" widget: delete `src/features/chat/widget.ts` (+ `widget.test.ts`) and `src/features/dashboard/ui/widgets/chat-widget.tsx`, update the catalog entry (`src/features/dashboard/registry/catalog.ts` ~line 160, `gallery-meta.ts` line 46, `widget-registry.tsx`, `ui/widgets/widgets.stories.tsx`). Saved dashboards may hold a widget of type `chat`: keep that type id working (or migrate it) so no saved instance is orphaned; record which.
- **Team widget's "now" line** (CH70): TV-H1 **is landed**, so the spec's "until TV-H1 lands" no longer applies. Register a component with `registerTeamNowLine` (`src/features/dashboard/team-now.ts`; props `{ workspaceId, userId, size }`) that draws Active · Focusing · Away · the saved status ("On vacation until Oct 20") from `chat_now` (CV-17) and presence; it renders nothing for someone with nothing to say; `team-widget.tsx` already leaves the slot above Tasks' load rows.
- **Lossless export** (round-3 §2.25 i, #31): in the client, every conversation you can read through the keyset reads, with chains, reactions and files **as files** (attachments and custom emoji), as JSON plus one Markdown file per conversation. Plug into `src/features/settings/advanced.ts` (`buildExportBundle`, `ModuleReadResult`; tests `data-export.test.ts`) with `src/features/chat/export.test.ts`. Your own saved statuses were added by CV-17.
- **Erasure:** extend `supabase/tests/chat_erasure.test.sql` (CV-1 started it) to every new per-person table: `chat_catchup`, `chat_chain_mutes`, `user_clients`, `user_statuses`, `user_saved_statuses`, and a custom emoji's `created_by` going to null; the preview counts them.
- **Shortcut sheet** (AC4.3): Chat's rows of §16 in `src/components/app/global-shortcuts-dialog.tsx` (+ test) and `src/lib/shortcuts.ts`; finish `tests/chat-keys.spec.ts` ("the key map": every row fires in its scope and nowhere else; ↑ edits the last message; Esc follows the order; `+` never fires inside the composer) for the rows CV-7a and CV-7b did not cover (anywhere in Chat, Catch up, the chain panel).

## 5. Files

New: `tests/chat-home.spec.ts`, `src/features/chat/export.test.ts`, the widget and now-line components. Touch: the dashboard registry files above, `team-now.ts` consumers, `src/features/settings/advanced.ts`, `global-shortcuts-dialog.tsx`, `src/lib/shortcuts.ts`, `supabase/tests/chat_erasure.test.sql`. No migration. Touch `src/lib/runtime*` only if the export needs a read; then it is Tier 2.

## 6. From earlier blocks

CV-11: the Catch up data read and view. CV-17: `chat_now`, presence, statuses. CV-9: files and CV-20: emoji images (the export writes them). CV-1: `chat_erasure.test.sql`. TV-H1's Team widget and its slot are landed.

## 7. Watch out

- The export reads through the same RLS as the app: it must never include a conversation you can't read.
- **Public repo:** describe no security weakness in any file; tell the orchestrator in the hand-back.

## 8. Out of scope for this block

The Catch up view and keys (CV-11); `chat_now` and statuses (CV-17); Tasks' load rows (TV-H1, landed); the MCP tools (CV-21).
